item.title: Combination Smoke + CO Alarm Beeping: Start With Safety, Then Check the Model
item.description: A combination alarm can warn about smoke, carbon monoxide, a low battery, a fault, or the end of its service life. Those signals are not interchangeable. If the unit is loud and repeating, or you cannot confidently identify the sound as a documented maintenance chirp, get people and pets outside first. For a possible CO alarm, the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission says to move to fresh air, call emergency services from outside, and stay out until responders say it is safe.
